title: Akiyama Mizuki — Smell You Later!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I know I need to keep my attendance up, but a whole day of classes is so exhausting.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Still, once homeroom's over...)

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: We'll now be choosing cheer squad members for the Sports Festival.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (The Sports Festival's one thing, but the cheer squad? I'd rather pass if it means standing out more than I need to...)

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: Since no one put their name in during our last homeroom, our class will be drawing straws.

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: Please say so if you draw a straw with “winner” in red letters written on it. Form a single-file line to the right and wait to draw your straw.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yikes... I've gotta get mine now!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Please, not me...
What...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mizuki? Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, hey! Looks like Akiyama drew one.

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line:
Alright, that's our first winner.
Everyone else, please keep checking to see what you get.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Grr... And I keep missing out on that anime song concert too... Why's my luck so rotten...?!

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: Shiraishi, you're up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, let's see...
Nope, not me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Hmm... But it could be fun to be on the cheer squad with Mizuki during the Sports Festival...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
O-Oh no...
I... I can't be on the cheer squad...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line:
That's all the straws.
There should be one other winner out there. Who drew it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, me! I'm the last one!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A-An?!

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: Ah, Shiraishi. Understood.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Man, An drew the short straw too.
I guess we can lick each other's wounds while griping about our bad luck.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Um, Shiraishi...
Are you really sure about taking my place?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I actually kinda wanted to be on the cheer squad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And not everybody's cut out for stuff like this, right? I really don't think there's any need to force yourself into doing anything for the Sports Festival.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So you can leave the cheering to me!
But in return, promise to do your best during the other events!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
O-Okay...!
I should be able to do that for at least the ball toss!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Great! That's the spirit!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So An took their place.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Um... Thank you so much, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, I should be the one thanking you!
Now I get to enjoy the Sports Festival with Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: Thank you for your cooperation, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: The representatives for our class have been decided, but the cheer squad is always looking for more recruits. Please feel free to ask to join at any time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, looks like we're both on the cheer squad now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup. I guess the Sports Festival won't be as boring as having to sit through classes just to keep up my attendance.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! I really doubt you'll be bored. I mean, our school's cheering competition's supposed to be pretty famous!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So let's do our best to make the Sports Festival really fun this year!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, okay...
